scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package : Insurance Scheme For Health Workers Fighting COVID-19
description:
The Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package was announced on March 26, 2020. 

This package was introduced as a response to the COVID-19 pandemic. 

It aimed to provide comprehensive support to the poor and vulnerable sections of society. 

One of the key components of this package was the Insurance Scheme for Health Workers. 

This scheme was specifically designed to offer financial protection to health workers combating COVID-19. 

The insurance coverage under this scheme was set at ₹50 lakh. 

This amount was provided to the families of health workers who succumbed to the virus while performing their duties. 

The scheme was applicable to a wide range of health workers. 

This included doctors, nurses, paramedics, and other frontline workers. 

The insurance was extended to both public and private sector health workers. 

The scheme was launched under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. 

It aimed to ensure that health workers received adequate support during the pandemic. 

The insurance coverage was applicable for a period of three months initially. 

However, it was later extended to cover the duration of the pandemic. 

The scheme was a significant step in recognizing the sacrifices made by health workers. 

It also aimed to boost morale among health professionals during the crisis. 

The insurance was provided through the New India Assurance Company Limited. 

This public sector insurance company was responsible for managing the claims. 

The scheme was designed to be hassle-free and quick in terms of claim processing. 

Health workers were required to register with their respective health departments. 

This registration was essential for availing the benefits of the insurance scheme. 

The scheme also included provisions for the families of deceased health workers. 

In case of an unfortunate demise, the family could claim the insurance amount. 

The claim process was simplified to ensure timely disbursement of funds. 

The scheme was announced as part of a larger economic relief package. 

The total financial outlay of the Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Package was ₹1.70 lakh crore. 

This package included various other welfare measures as well. 

The insurance scheme was one of the most critical components of this package. 

It highlighted the government's commitment to supporting health workers. 

The scheme was particularly important given the high-risk nature of healthcare during the pandemic. 

Health workers faced significant exposure to the virus while treating patients. 

The scheme aimed to alleviate the financial burden on their families in case of loss. 

The insurance scheme was applicable across all states and union territories in India. 

It provided a uniform safety net for health workers nationwide. 

The scheme was also publicized through various media channels. 

This ensured that health workers were aware of the benefits available to them. 

The government emphasized the importance of health workers in combating the pandemic. 

The scheme was a recognition of their dedication and hard work. 

The insurance policy was designed to cover accidental death due to COVID-19. 

It also included provisions for hospitalization expenses related to the virus. 

The scheme was part of the government's broader strategy to fight COVID-19. 

It aimed to ensure that health workers felt secure while performing their duties. 

The initiative was well-received by various health organizations and unions. 

Many praised the government for taking steps to protect frontline workers. 

The scheme also aimed to encourage more individuals to join the healthcare workforce.
